title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: usage reports in the Microsoft Graph API
summary: Hold: the briefing attributes per-app last activity dates to both user-detail functions, but the by-date function returns activity flags and counts instead. The roadmap facts, access controls and concealment setting are supported; the by-date preview qualification and a few control details also need small corrections.
